comparisons.peer_summary: The company outsources the manufacturing of board-level graphics products to third-party manufacturers.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose reliance on third-party manufacturing within their supply chain, but their specific engagement strategies and focus areas differ significantly. NVIDIA explicitly details a climate change initiative aiming to engage manufacturing suppliers regarding Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and the adoption of science-based targets by fiscal year 2026. In contrast, AMD's disclosure focuses solely on the operational fact of outsourcing board-level graphics product manufacturing to third-party manufacturers, without mentioning environmental targets, emissions reduction goals, or supplier engagement initiatives for sustainability.
